name: Acute generalised exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP)
advice: Stop the suspected drug (commonly beta-lactams, macrolides, hydroxychloroquine, terbinafine, diltiazem) and never take it again — carry a drug allergy card. Pustules are sterile; antibiotics are not needed. Tests: CBC, LFT, creatinine; patch test after recovery. Clears in about 2 weeks with peeling.
